title: Nairobi Street Sprint: Avenue Challenge
briefing: Welcome to this Nairobi-inspired street sprint. Navigate the Avenue route by hitting every native checkpoint in sequence. Precision is key; heavy contact with traffic or barriers will trigger a recovery penalty, slowing your momentum. Keep your speed steady and your lines clean to secure the fastest time on the leaderboard.

radio.start: Green flag is out. Keep it clean and watch your lines on the Avenue.
radio.finish: Chequered flag. Return to the paddock.
